prayerExcerpt.en-US: I spoke, O Lord, of your decrees before kings, and was not confounded.

meta.face: John as on the john_baptist card, made ascetic by prison: a lean man of about thirty with a LONG face — high cheekbones over hollowed cheeks, a straight nose, large dark-brown eyes under straight dark brows, a firm mouth; thick, unkempt curly dark-brown hair to the shoulders and a rough, short dark-brown beard; the gaze lifted to the light, steadfast and at peace. Not a Christ type: wild hair, weathered skin, wilderness gauntness.
meta.basis: John keeps the face of the existing john_baptist card. Josephus names Machaerus, above the Dead Sea, as his prison and place of death; Mark 6:17-29 tells of the imprisonment and the beheading, which the card leaves to the sword implied in the doorway.
